# SolidMaint

> Property maintenance on the Costa del Sol, Spain. Garden, pool, jacuzzi, AC, handyman, plumbing and electrical care for homes in Marbella, Estepona, Benalmádena, Fuengirola, Mijas, Benahavís and Sotogrande. A Nordic-rooted team; every visit documented with photos and reports in a free Property Vault.

- Care plans: Essential Care, Home Ready (3 maintenance hours/month) and Signature Care (6 hours/month); unused hours roll over. Prices include IVA and cover services only; materials are quoted separately.
- Contact: info@solidmaint.com · +34 951 798 899 · Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00 CET
